observations: Photo 0 shows a Mercedes transmission/gearbox assembly on the ground with a large bellhousing and an attached housing/cover; there is a label/plate area but the key ID text is not clearly readable.
Photo 1 shows the inside/bellhousing side with visible clutch/torque-converter area and ring gear teeth; no clear model/part number is readable.
Photo 2 shows the gearbox from another angle with the bellhousing and housing casing; again, no clearly readable OEM code/plate.

identity.kind: Mercedes automatic transmission gearbox (OEM part claimed)

claims.claim: Transmissions Gearbox M278 1282 OEM G63, Mercedes transmission gearbox.
claims.evidence: The photos show a Mercedes gearbox, but the specific identifiers 'M278 1282' and 'G63' are not clearly readable on the casing/label in photo 0/2, and no matching part number is legible in photo 1.
No test/working proof (video, scan, fluid condition, or bench test) is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Wrong gearbox variant/part number (even within Mercedes, different bellhousing/gear ratios/TC variants exist). Photos do not show a readable OEM code.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the OEM/part number label/plate on the gearbox casing (and/or the transmission code sticker) plus a photo of the VIN/vehicle it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the worst-case: unknown/possibly wrong variant and not guaranteed to fit; treat as non-working/for parts until verified.

risks.risk: Internal damage or wear not visible externally (clutches, solenoids, torque converter, valve body).
risks.proof: Video of a bench test or at minimum a scan report (fault codes) from the vehicle it was removed from, plus photos of fluid condition (drain plug area) and any metal debris.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / needs overhaul.

risks.risk: Missing components or incomplete kit (torque converter, sensors, harness connectors, mounting brackets).
risks.proof: Inventory photo: show all included parts laid out, and close-ups of sensor ports/connectors and mounting points; confirm torque converter included or not.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown contents; assume missing items may require additional purchase.

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage (cracked housing, damaged mounting ears, bent shafts) not obvious in these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all edges, mounting ears, and any casting seams; include a photo of the input shaft/connector area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged until inspected.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the transmission OEM part number / transmission code sticker (photo 0 label area) and any stamped codes.
Photo of the torque converter (if included) and confirmation whether it is included.
Video proof of operation from the vehicle it came from (or scan report showing no transmission faults).
Inventory/included-parts photo: sensors, harness connectors, mounting brackets, and any adapters.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Mercedes gearbox assembly, but the specific claimed identifiers (M278 1282 / G63) and working condition are not verifiable from the images. Without a readable OEM code and proof of operation, the correct variant and condition—and therefore a safe price—cannot be determined.
